methodology.testImportLocation: Where a spec that imports the tool's handler module lives: packages/mcp-server/test/product-reality, then test/contracts, then any other mcp-server spec. A literal runtime import is source evidence that a test reaches the handler, not proof of invocation, passing execution or browser certification. Grouped action imports roll up to their registered family. Transitive imports and constructed imports/dispatch are not followed; type-only and schema-only imports do not count.
methodology.certifiedReceipts: Receipts of an independently certified review that recorded a call to the tool, each hash-bound at generation and named by the decision that certified it. They describe the build that review certified (its bundle head), not necessarily this one.
methodology.portableE2E: Literal callTool names in scripts/runtime/e2e.mjs; source coverage only, not a claim this census executed the portable E2E.
methodology.caveats: Limits anchored to one line of source. Where a caveat carries observed, the limits probe receipt shows the behaviour on the packed runtime, and generation fails if the observation stops matching.
methodology.portableExecution: Per-tool pass or typed dependency outcomes for the exercised inputs from the hash-bound packaged-runtime E2E receipt. Its bundle head and dirty state are retained separately from this source census head. Certification is the independent review's.

advertisedClaim.name: tokens_build
advertisedClaim.description: Compile registered brand tokens with the shipped compiler. Use it when you need fresh CSS and JSON; use brand_create to create a brand or brand_apply to change its source. Returns inline CSS variables, CSS and JSON plus artifact paths, hashes and sizes. apply:true builds in isolated artifact storage; omission previews the artifacts without writing. Requested brand/theme selects the inline scope; full CSS includes every registered scope. Source and shipped runtime files stay unchanged. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#tokens_build; full schema: oods://schemas/tokens_build.input.json.

caveats.reason: Requested-scope JSON and CSS resolve brand/theme. Full CSS retains every built scope; TypeScript and Tailwind artifacts explicitly retain legacy A/light defaults.

advertisedClaim.name: structured_data_fetch
advertisedClaim.description: Fetch live registry datasets, archived token/export data, or captured-run artifacts. Use it when you need complete machine-readable data; use catalog_list instead for component selection, object_registry for one object's definition, or registry_snapshot for mappings together with traits and objects. Returns data with provenance, version and cache metadata. dataset selects registry/export mode; version pins an archived export and listVersions lists dates. kind plus runPath selects captured artifacts, while derived_analysis reads an analysis directory via runPath; version/listVersions are refused in kind mode. includeInternal exposes hidden objects, and ifNoneMatch checks the canonical payload ETag. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#structured_data_fetch; full schema: oods://schemas/structured_data_fetch.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Read structured datasets or Stage1 rollups. listVersions and version are dataset-only; kind mode rejects these options with structuredData.fetch-specific OODS-V202.

advertisedClaim.name: brand_apply
advertisedClaim.description: Preview or apply changes to an existing brand's canonical token source. Use it when editing a brand; use brand_create to create one. Returns validation, changed slots, before/after hashes and build evidence. delta is required and supports aliases or add/remove/replace patches. apply defaults to a dry run that writes nothing. apply:true validates first, then writes source and rebuilds; build failure leaves source edits in place. For shipped brands in the portable runtime, apply emits a review kit and reports source/build steps as skipped. User brands rebuild in their own folder. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#brand_apply; full schema: oods://schemas/brand_apply.input.json.

caveats.reason: A failed real token build returns OODS-S019 with captured output and receipts. Source writes are deliberately left in place for inspection and repair; no automatic rollback is claimed.

For the brands OODS Foundry ships, apply:true from the runtime writes a review kit (snapshots and specimens, no variables.css) and changes nothing: no brand source is written and no token build runs, and the receipt records both steps as skipped. A team's brand in its brands folder is written and rebuilt there, from the runtime too.

Only a brand the token build carries: the shipped build carries A and B, and from npm a team's brands are built from ~/.oods-foundry/brands beside them; any other brand is refused with OODS-V001 naming the known brands.

advertisedClaim.name: brand_create
advertisedClaim.description: Create and inspect brands from token documents or a six-value recipe. Use it when adding a brand; use brand_apply to edit an existing brand or tokens_build to compile current sources. Returns templates, validation reports, derived recipes with provenance/gaps, or a created brand and build results. action selects template, validate, derive or create. derive accepts exactly one of tokens, css or cssPath; review gaps before creating. create validates every theme, refuses replacement, writes into your brands folder and builds tokens. Template and validation calls write nothing. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#brand_create; full schema: oods://schemas/brand_create.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: derive reads a team's DTCG tokens or a shadcn CSS theme into a partial recipe with provenance, gaps and warnings, writing nothing. Create a brand from token values or a recipe. template returns every slot of a brand with its meaning and a starting value, or from a recipe the complete brand it gives, graded; validate checks the filled documents or a recipe and writes nothing; create writes a brand that passes into the brands folder and runs the token build.

caveats.reason: From an extracted runtime archive with no brands folder set, create is refused with OODS-N025; the npm launcher sets ~/.oods-foundry/brands, where create writes a brand and builds it, outside the runtime.

derive accepts a team's own DTCG token names to infer a recipe with provenance and gaps. Generated apps still use OODS Foundry's slot names; the team's names are not carried into them. Missing values must be supplied before create.

advertisedClaim.name: catalog_list
advertisedClaim.description: List components from the live component-contract registry. Use it when choosing components by category, trait or rendering context; use structured_data_fetch instead for complete datasets, object_registry for full object definitions, or registry_snapshot for mappings together with traits and objects. Returns component names, categories, readiness labels and availableCategories; detail controls added tags, contexts, regions, traits and evidence. includeInternal exposes hidden registry objects. Readiness evidence retains the build it measured and does not certify a new composition. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#catalog_list; full schema: oods://schemas/catalog_list.input.json.

caveats.reason: propSchema describes the static HTML renderer and lists props for seven primitives only; every component's React and Vue props are in propTypes, read from the published declarations.

advertisedClaim.name: code_generate
advertisedClaim.description: Generate React/Vue file sets or a standalone static HTML document from a validated UiSchema. Use it when a schema already exists; use design_compose instead to choose a layout or pipeline_run to compose, validate, render and generate together. Returns versioned artifacts, exact dependencies, required domain handlers and validationReceipt. Supply schema or schemaRef before its 30-minute expiry. profile selects draft/build/release; build performs static checks, while release verifies supplied evidence without rerunning it. options.output selects component/application and options.payloadMode:file returns file references. Domain actions require consumer handlers. React shadcn mappings support components/apps; workflows refuse them. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#code_generate; full schema: oods://schemas/code_generate.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Generate framework-specific code from a validated UiSchema. A workflow schema generates a runnable React or Vue application with navigation, local store and deterministic sample data.

caveats.reason: Local JSON evidence files are opened and SHA-256, passed status and artifact binding are verified; evidence is not re-executed.
Static HTML domain actions show an integration notice; local edits and list controls do not persist records or implement application navigation. Browser coverage is separate from build validation.

The build profile runs static checks (schema, registry, contracts, dependency closure); it never compiles, typechecks or runs the code. Only HTML inspects and records fallback-policy; React/Vue disclose it as not checked.

advertisedClaim.name: design_compose
advertisedClaim.description: Compose an object screen or workflow into a UiSchema. Use it when choosing layout and components; use pipeline_run instead for the complete generation flow or code_generate when you already have a schema. Returns schema, a 30-minute process-local schemaRef and durable compositionId/version lineage. Prefer explicit object and context over keyword-based intent. preferences controls region/field order and sample seed; compositionId appends a version, while options.transient records none. Save schemas with schema_store to reuse across sessions. Selected nodes snapshot component mappings; composition does not generate or run an app. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#design_compose; full schema: oods://schemas/design_compose.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Generate a UiSchema from an object definition and/or an intent sentence (matched against fixed keyword and phrase tables) using layout templates and component selection. Provide at least one of 'intent' or 'object'. context=workflow assembles a routed, stateful application from the object's list/detail/form/timeline compositions. Every successful composition is recorded as a durable version beside the saved-schema store (compositions/<compositionId>/versions/<n>.json); pass compositionId to record the result as that composition's next version.

caveats.reason: An intent sentence is matched against keyword tables. A sentence with no layout keyword uses the dashboard default without numeric confidence and reports OODS-V116; no object is chosen. Naming an object and a context is the reliable input.

advertisedClaim.name: design_preview
advertisedClaim.description: Open a versioned composition as a running React/Vue app with recorded measurements. Use it when reviewing generated behavior or edits; use fidelity_preview instead for static diagrams, wireframes or mockups. Returns preview URLs, composition lineage, editable fields and measured/notMeasured evidence. Supply compositionId/version or object/context; action selects render, edit, compare or versions. Edits create a new version. framework and preferences select rendering; contextItems attach fetched evidence. runPath selects captured-run records, analysisPath selects derived comparisons, and recordId chooses an exact record. Writes version artifacts and measurements; domain actions still require consumer integration. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#design_preview; full schema: oods://schemas/design_preview.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Open a composition version as the generated React or Vue app actually running in a browser: either an existing compositionId (and optional version) or an object and context composed now as a new composition. The preview host (in the HTTP bridge, or started by the stdio adapter) compiles the artifact and serves it at one URL per version with its lineage and brand, theme and width controls. action "compare" prepares missing generated artifacts for both versions in the requested frameworks, then returns the structural what-changed (including props on and inside slots and objectSchema fields in the definition category; identical requires equal schema hashes) between this version and `against` (regions, slots, nodes, props, field order, seed, artifact file hashes) with the side-by-side URL. action "accept" records the version as the composition's accepted version with a snapshot of its measurements.

caveats.reason: Requires a reachable preview host: the HTTP bridge hosts it in-process and the stdio adapter starts it; a native server run on its own, a host reading another schema store root, or a platform without a bundled esbuild binary returns retryable OODS-N021.

The MCP Apps SDK reference host v1.7.5 rendered React and Vue inside the conversation with OODS_MCP_APPS_UI=1 through a local HTTP-to-stdio relay and a fixed-file serving adjustment for the hidden checkout. Default negotiation advertises no UI capability and returns text. No run in Claude Desktop or Cursor is recorded; their instructions come from their documentation.

Plain app-page actions show an integration notice and do not change records or navigate. Workflow apps use their own local store. Preview records use authored examples/defaults or neutral typed values.

advertisedClaim.name: pipeline_run
advertisedClaim.description: Run composition, validation, rendering and code generation in one call. Use it when starting from an object/context or intent and needing generated output; use design_compose instead to inspect layout first or code_generate for an existing schema. Returns step results, schemaRef with expiry, versioned artifacts, dependencies and validationReceipt. options controls validation/render skipping and optional static accessibility checks; save persists the schema beyond its process-local 30-minute reference. Generation validation forwards draft/build/release without downgrade. Release verifies supplied evidence without rerunning it; unresolved accessibility pairs stay unmeasured. Calls may write composition and saved-schema records. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#pipeline_run; full schema: oods://schemas/pipeline_run.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Execute the full design pipeline (compose -> validate -> render -> codegen) in a single call. A workflow schema generates a runnable React or Vue application with navigation, local store and deterministic sample data.

caveats.reason: Local JSON evidence files are opened and SHA-256, passed status and artifact binding are verified; evidence is not re-executed.

Opt-in validation inspects shared-renderer HTML and declared component CSS token pairs for every built scope. It reports static findings and unmeasured pairs; browser-computed colour, keyboard/focus interaction and screen-reader behavior are outside this check.

advertisedClaim.name: health_check
advertisedClaim.description: Read server readiness, live registry/store counts and retained proof summaries. Use it when checking availability and built brand/theme scopes; use object_registry for definitions or registry_snapshot for mappings. Returns status, server uptime, registry counts, token scopes and productReality evidence. status:ok means sources were readable; retained proofs identify their measured build and do not automatically certify this one. includeChangelog and sinceVersion filter the reported DSL changelog. tokens.defaultScope is configured metadata rather than an observed consumer scope; missing scope data is unavailable. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#health_check; full schema: oods://schemas/health_check.input.json.

caveats.reason: Health lists built token scopes and labels configured defaults; it does not observe a consumer scope.

"ok" means health could read its files. The reference-app proof it reports measured an earlier archive (thisBuild:false), and the runtime and tool proof heads it reports are not compared with the build answering.

advertisedClaim.name: registry_snapshot
advertisedClaim.description: Read mappings together with active traits and objects in one snapshot. Use it when needing a combined registry view and canonical ETag; use catalog_list instead to choose components, structured_data_fetch for an individual dataset, or object_registry to inspect/register a definition. Returns mappings, traits, objects, generatedAt, ETag and registry loader issues. includeInternal exposes hidden objects; otherwise hiddenInternal counts omitted entries. Team definitions and shadowing are reported from live sources. This read-only call writes no snapshot file. Historical mapping fields remain stored data and do not imply current capabilities. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#registry_snapshot; full schema: oods://schemas/registry_snapshot.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Bulk-read recorded mappings plus live shipped and registered team traits and objects. Reports definition loader issues, including shadowed names. Draft preferred_terms, disambiguation_decisions and capabilities are not snapshot outputs.

advertisedClaim.name: viz_render
advertisedClaim.description: Render one data-bound chart from rows or a structured data operand. Use it when creating chart output; use artifact_certify instead to grade a normalized chart or dashboard_render for multiple panels and KPIs. Returns Vega-Lite or ECharts specs, chart identities and requested SVG/accessibility output. pattern uses bundled data and forbids explicit data/encoding/presentation overrides. Otherwise use chartType plus encodings, omit chartType for recommendations, or supply structured intent. ECharts-primary families require their matching hierarchy/network/geo operand. brand/theme controls pixels; output.includeNormalizedSpec returns the IR required by artifact_certify. Temporal rendering uses UTC. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#viz_render; full schema: oods://schemas/viz_render.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Render a real, data-bound visualization. Supply a registered pattern identity to preserve its source data and presentation, chartType + encodings for explicit mode, or rows/datasetRef for suggest or structured-intent mode. Retired patterns are not offered; structurally unsupported patterns return OODS-V167; pattern conflicts with explicit data, intent, or source identity/presentation overrides return OODS-V166. Brand, theme and output controls remain available.

advertisedClaim.name: dashboard_render
advertisedClaim.description: Render coordinated charts and KPIs from shared datasets and panel definitions. Use it when composing a dashboard; use viz_render instead for one chart or artifact_certify to grade each returned normalized chart. Returns layout, per-panel specs/hashes, computed KPI values, accessibility data and a reusable specRef. output.includeNormalizedSpec includes panel IR; output.html adds rendered HTML. brand/theme controls emitted pixels; selection and crossFilter apply caller-supplied filtering. resolveMeasures defaults true for governed measure references. output.contrastScan is a four-pair token preflight, not whole-document certification. Chord and flow_map are excluded from dashboards. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#dashboard_render; full schema: oods://schemas/dashboard_render.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Render a composed, decision-centric DASHBOARD (the fixed metric-overview template: KPI row + trend + breakdown + optional geo) from a declarative DashboardSpec IR. Carries shared datasets, heterogeneous panels (any of the 11 of the 13 viz.render chartTypes (chord and flow_map are viz.render-only, decision #881), or kpi tiles), layout hints, cross-filter links, and a dashboard-level a11y block. The server composes each panel through the in-process viz.render engine, resolves the layout (m02), computes KPIs (m03), and applies any active cross-filter selection (m03/m04). Option C: per-chart specs are unchanged; this IR sits above them.

caveats.reason: Declared links appear as a labelled reference list in HTML. They do not apply filters; active filtering reads selection and crossFilter.

advertisedClaim.name: artifact_certify
advertisedClaim.description: Grade a normalized chart's accessibility equivalence, determinism, contrast and accuracy. Use it when checking the IR returned by viz_render or dashboard_render; use viz_render instead to create chart output and dashboard_render to compose panels. Returns coverage, conformant, findings and four pillar verdicts. Pass spec alone for Cartesian charts; ECharts-primary charts need the same matching data branch used for rendering. Spec-only ECharts remains uncertified. brand/theme must match rendering; high contrast reports forced-colors exemption without a numeric contrast grade. A certified chart may still be nonconformant; inspect all verdicts. This read-only check does not repair charts. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#artifact_certify; full schema: oods://schemas/artifact_certify.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Certify a OODS Foundry NormalizedVizSpec at a CSS theme and brand (default light/A). The handler validates the permissive spec boundary against the authoritative viz-core IR schema. ECharts-primary IR is metadata-only: supply the same data operand used by viz.render for render-backed determinism, contrast and accuracy. Without data, categorical ECharts contrast reconstructs the scoped baked palette and makes no rendered-carrier measurement claim. HC contrast is exempt with reason forced-colors and no numeric grade; determinism, a11y and accuracy retain their normal evaluation. The data-backed ECharts paints come from the rendered projected option; geo render evidence remains exempt with no canvas ratio.

caveats.reason: Certifies chart specifications only. It never certifies a screen, an application, a page or HTML; generated code carries a validation receipt instead.

advertisedClaim.name: fidelity_preview
advertisedClaim.description: Draw object relationships or compositions at four fidelity levels. Use it when reviewing static structure or appearance; use design_preview instead to run generated React/Vue behavior. Returns SVG or HTML with fidelity-specific structure and provenance. fidelityKind selects boxes-arrows, wireframe, review or branded-mockup. Supply exactly one object, objects set, schema/schemaRef, fixture or legacy manifest; object/context composes a screen. Object diagrams show declared relationships; schema diagrams show containment. Wireframe/review show component bindings and recorded confidence, and branded mockups use static sample data. options.brandOverlay/theme selects built tokens. These drawings do not certify usability or referential integrity. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#fidelity_preview; full schema: oods://schemas/fidelity_preview.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Render OODS Foundry object relationships or composed component trees. Exactly one object, objects set, schemaRef, UiSchema, fixture or legacy manifest. Wireframes follow regions/components/field bindings; composition diagrams show containment. Named fixtures are packaged registry data.

caveats.reason: Legacy Object Catalog branded mockups resolve built light tokens. Composed branded mockups use the HTML generation path with the chosen brand and theme. Unknown brands fail explicitly.

Object boxes-arrows draws declared associations as dagre SVG, bounded to 48 objects and 128 edges; it does not join live records or verify referential integrity. Composition diagrams show containment only. Composed wireframes draw the lowered component tree with regions and field bindings; legacy manifests retain their entity/slot projection.

Historical archive probe: every named fixture returned OODS-FP-002 because the nine files were absent. The current runtime includes the allow-listed fixtures into shipped registry data; this retained observation describes the older probed archive, not the current source.

advertisedClaim.name: component_map
advertisedClaim.description: Manage component substitutions in your user mapping store. Use it when connecting your React/Vue component exports or React shadcn source to OODS components; use catalog_list to find OODS component names. Returns mapping entries, resolved matches or per-entry write outcomes. action selects apply/create/list/resolve/update/delete. create accepts a single entry, mappings list or mappingsPath; lists validate completely before one write. substitution supplies exports and prop translations with exact package versions or installed localPath. React shadcn mappings use an installed project and module instead. Compose snapshots mappings; generation/preview apply them. apply controls mutation where supported. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#component_map; full schema: oods://schemas/component_map.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Manage mappings in your user folder (create, list, resolve, update, delete, apply). Create accepts one mapping, a mappings list, or an absolute mappingsPath to a checked mapping file; the list is validated whole and written atomically. Optional substitutions name a shipped OODS Foundry component and React/Vue package exports with prop translations validated against its contract. Legacy Stage1 annotations remain round-trip data.

caveats.reason: Compose records substitutions and React/Vue codegen emits team imports, translated props and exact dependencies. Preview bundles installed or localPath packages and freezes them per version. Shared-scenario checks execute through the generated adapters when the preview host has a browser. Unavailable and unimplemented probes remain not-checked, and unmet obligations warn without refusing generation. Legacy Stage1 coercion labels remain annotations.
Trait discovery uses live shipped and team folders. Unknown trait annotations are retained with a warning; substitution props and imports are validated before persistence.

advertisedClaim.name: schema_store
advertisedClaim.description: Save, load, list or delete named composition schemas. Use it when retaining a UiSchema across sessions or past its 30-minute reference expiry; use schema_render to validate/render it or object_registry to manage object definitions. Returns the selected stored schema, listing or write result. action selects the operation; save/load/delete use name. Every save overwrites that name and increments its version; only the latest is loadable. apply is accepted but ignored: save and delete always write. Full tool JSON schemas are separate MCP resources, not entries in this store. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#schema_store; full schema: oods://schemas/schema_store.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Grouped action-parameter tool for the schema family (save, load, list, delete). The `action` field selects the per-action handler; each branch reproduces the exact body of the corresponding per-action input schema plus the discriminator key. Uses plain JSON-Schema if/then (no AJV discriminator keyword).

caveats.reason: apply is accepted and ignored: save persists without apply:true. version counts saves under a name; each save overwrites the one file, so earlier versions are not kept.

advertisedClaim.name: object_registry
advertisedClaim.description: Inspect, validate or register object and trait definitions. Use object_import instead to draft from existing schema files. Use it when exploring object shapes with list/show; use catalog_list instead to choose components, structured_data_fetch for complete datasets, or registry_snapshot for mappings together with definitions. Returns definitions, composed traits/view extensions, validation findings or registry write/reload results. action selects list/show/validate/register/reload. includeInternal reveals hidden objects. validate/register accept YAML; register writes your configured folder after checking declared contexts, and overwrite replaces your own definition. Team objects may shadow shipped objects; traits cannot reuse shipped names. Relationships validate their target and field. Reload reads folders without restarting. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#object_registry; full schema: oods://schemas/object_registry.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Grouped action-parameter tool for the object registry (list, show, validate, register, reload). The top-level `action` selects which per-action contract applies; each branch reproduces the exact body of the per-action input schema (object.<action>.input.json) with the discriminator key `action` added to its allowed properties.

caveats.reason: A team's own trait may place only the components the runtime ships; validate and register refuse any other component. Mapped implementations replace shipped ids; new catalog components are not supported.

register writes only where OODS_OBJECTS_DIR or OODS_TRAITS_DIR points. The npm launcher sets them under ~/.oods-foundry; from the runtime archive or a source checkout they have no default and register returns OODS-N023 until they are set.

advertisedClaim.name: schema_render
advertisedClaim.description: Validate a UiSchema or render it as static HTML/fragments. Use it when checking schema/patch contracts or exporting static output; use design_preview for a running React/Vue app, code_generate for file sets, or schema_store for persistence. Returns validation diagnostics or rendered output with warnings and artifact references. action selects validate/render; mode selects full schema or patch, with schemaRef available for reuse. Render defaults to a document with token CSS; output.compact omits CSS. brand and output scope options affect documents; ignored fragment options are diagnosed. apply:true emits render artifacts; output.payloadMode:file writes payloads and returns paths. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#schema_render; full schema: oods://schemas/schema_render.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Grouped action-parameter tool consolidating repl.render and repl.validate. Select the per-action body via the top-level `action` discriminator. Each branch reproduces the exact body of the corresponding per-action input schema, with `action` added to the allowed property set. Per-action handlers, schemas, and the external repl_render/repl_validate tools are unchanged; this is a zero-functionality-loss bolt-on.

caveats.reason: Fragment output emits typed warnings for ignored document scope controls. Non-strict unknown-component errors remain visible per node with OODS-W002; validate.apply is bridge parity.

Document rendering uses authored examples/defaults or neutral typed sample values. Fragment output retains its component-fragment contract. Compact output must be requested explicitly and omits token CSS.

Opt-in validation inspects shared-renderer HTML and declared component CSS token pairs for every built scope. It reports static findings and unmeasured pairs; browser-computed colour, keyboard/focus interaction and screen-reader behavior are outside this check.

advertisedClaim.name: object_import
advertisedClaim.description: Draft objects from local OpenAPI, JSON Schema, Postgres DDL/migrations, Prisma, dbt, OData or GraphQL files. Use it when importing a schema you already have; use object_registry for hand-written object/trait YAML. Returns an importId, staged drafts/report, counts and a re-import diff. action=draft uses source.path or source.content without registering; show uses importId and object for YAML, graded proposals and unmapped elements; apply uses importId and explicit objects with accepted proposal ids. The batch validates and composes with rollback. overwrite replaces team objects; confirmShipped names each approved shipped replacement. Unreachable references are reported and skipped; no network fetch or code execution. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#object_import; full schema: oods://schemas/object_import.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Draft from local OpenAPI, JSON Schema, Postgres DDL/migrations, Prisma, dbt, OData or GraphQL files, inspect one staged draft, or explicitly accept a batch. No network access or code execution.

caveats.reason: Local files only, aggregate128MiB cap. Network, outside-folder and named-anchor references are refused; unresolved local pointers are explicitly unmapped.
Explicit acceptance only; detected batch failures restore prior definitions. This rollback does not provide crash or power-loss recovery.

advertisedClaim.name: a11y_scan
advertisedClaim.description: Grade built token contrast and optional static screen accessibility. Use it when checking component token pairs and HTML structure; use artifact_certify for chart pillars or design_preview for measured browser evidence. Returns measured pairs, document findings and explicit unmeasured cases. Without a schema it checks every built brand/theme; a UiSchema scopes pairs to its components and adds static HTML checks. Dynamic/inherited/system paints remain unmeasured. Browser layout, keyboard/focus and screen-reader behavior are not tested. apply:true writes the report, transcript and bundle index; omission writes nothing. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#a11y_scan; full schema: oods://schemas/a11y_scan.input.json.
advertisedClaim.inputSchemaDescription: Checks declared foreground/background pairs derived from shared component CSS against current built tokens for every registered brand and theme, including team brands. With a UiSchema, renders through the shared HTML renderer and checks document language/title, one main landmark, unique IDs, ARIA reference targets, control names/labels, image alternatives, chart SVG name/description, and heading names/order. Reports unresolved inherited surfaces, dynamic CSS, alpha compositing and OS colours as unmeasured. Does not check browser-computed colour/layout, keyboard/focus interaction or screen-reader behavior; no complete WCAG conformance claim.

caveats.reason: Grades declared component CSS pairs against every current built brand/theme, plus optional static shared-renderer HTML rules. Does not execute a browser or claim complete WCAG conformance; unresolved surfaces, dynamic CSS, alpha and OS colours remain unmeasured. Preview writes nothing.
